test_series_reductions: test pandas Series reduction operations (sum, prod, min, max, mean, median, var, std, skew, kurt, any, all) on Int64 dtype
test_dataframe_reductions: test pandas DataFrame reduction operations on columns with Int64 nullable integer dtype
test_groupby_reductions: test pandas groupby reduction operations on nullable Int64 columns with missing values
test_mixed_reductions: test pandas reduction operations on mixed nullable and non-nullable columns in Series and DataFrame
test_mixed_reduction_nan_not_influenced_: test that nullable Int64 columns do not affect NaN handling in non-nullable columns during skew and kurt reduction
